newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean shares end firm, rally seen continuing.
newsitem.headline: Chilean shares end firm, rally seen continuing.

text.p: Chilean blue chips closed stronger in thin trade with stocks propelled higher Tuesday by Wall Street's afternoon rally, dealers said.
"We won't see a correction here until buying from the U.S. stops. But demand there is still real," said one dealer.
The 40-share index ended up 0.57 percent at 115.86 points. The general index gained 0.36 percent at 5,358.62 points amid volume of eight billion pesos.
Profit-taking continued among local investors keen to take advantage of demand abroad for Chile stocks, said dealers.
"Locals are selling while foreigners are adding to their positions," said one dealer.
Traders noted that non-ADR shares could soon start to outshine ADR stocks which have led the bolsa's rally this year, with investors looking for stocks offering higher growth.
Winners included telecom Telex, up 3.3 percent at 1,095 pesos, bottler Andina up 1.71 percent at 2,380 pesos and drug-maker LabChile which rose 1.05 percent at 385 pesos.
Losers included shipping company Vapores, down 2.91 percent at 300 pesos and power utility Chilgener which shed 1.37 percent at 2,525 pesos.
